--- 命令 ---
echo "===== 部署可定论黑匣子v2.0 287323 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
echo "[1]写脚本:"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
chmod +x /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
bash -n /root/offline_watch_v2.sh && echo "  语法OK md5=$(md5sum /root/offline_watch_v2.sh|cut -c1-8)" || { echo "  语法失败中止"; exit 1; }
echo "[2]备份旧脚本,新脚本接管offline_watch路径:"
cp /root/offline_watch.sh /root/offline_watch_v1.bak 2>/dev/null
cp /root/offline_watch_v2.sh /root/offline_watch.sh
echo "  旧版已备份,新版已就位"
echo "[3]停旧进程,拉起v2独立进程:"
pkill -f 'bash /root/offline_watch.sh' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'bash /root/offline_watch_v2.sh' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
rm -rf /root/.offline_watch_v2.lock 2>/dev/null
( setsid nohup bash /root/offline_watch.sh >> /root/offline_watch2.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )
sleep 3
pgrep -af 'offline_watch' | head -3 || echo "  未拉起!"
echo "[4]验证自启守卫(v6+start_all):"
for f in /root/remote_ctl_v6.sh /root/start_all.sh; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  if grep -q 'offline_watch' "$f"; then echo "  $f 已有offline_watch守卫"; else echo "  $f 缺守卫!"; fi
done
echo "[5]跑一次自检验证取证+推送通道(真实推GitHub):"
OW_SELFTEST=1 bash /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
sleep 2
echo "  运行日志尾:"; tail -6 /root/offline_watch2.log
echo "  取证报告行数:"; wc -l /root/offline_forensics.log
echo "[6]验收:"
echo "  v2进程:"; pgrep -af 'offline_watch' | head -3
echo "=====完====="
